summary: Iteration 27 (frontend-only) verified the AppModals extraction (~440 lines of modal JSX moved from NotesApp.jsx → notes/AppModals.jsx) and the useGroceryQuickAdd hook (hooks/useGroceryQuickAdd.js) consolidating Barcode+Pantry duplicated grocery-add logic. NO REGRESSIONS FOUND. All 12 header buttons still open their respective modals via AppModals mount: header-quick-add (IconPicker), header-tile-packs (TilePacksModal), header-calendar (FloatingCalendarModal), header-language (LanguagePicker), header-insights (insights-modal), header-kid-mode (KidDashboardModal), header-meal-planner (meal-planner-modal), header-pantry (pantry-modal), header-barcode (barcode-scanner-modal), header-trip-journal (trip-journal-modal), archive-trash-btn (ArchiveTrashModal), settings-btn (SettingsModal). FAB add-note flow verified end-to-end: fab-add-note → NoteModal → note-title-input='TEST_RefactorNote' → note-content-input='body' → Create → note appears in list. Meal Planner list generation verified: header-meal-planner → meal-slot click → recipe-picker → recipe-option-* selected → meal-generate-list-btn enabled → clicked → toast 'Shopping list created · 9 items' → meal-planner-modal auto-closed → new Grocery note appeared in main list (5 notes total, #grocery and #meal-plan tags visible). This proves the AppModals→onGeneratedGroceryNote={() => p.fetchData()} wiring is correct. Multi-select flow verified: select-mode-toggle → clicking 2 note tiles → multiselect-bar visible → multiselect-studio-btn → batch-studio-sheet visible with Move/Duplicate/Pin/Color/Alarm/Export/Delete all present → bs-delete → delete-choice-dialog visible with delete-choice-archive + delete-choice-trash → Archive → recent-action-pill visible → Undo → 'Restored' toast + notes returned to list. This proves AppModals→MultiSelectBar/BatchStudioSheet/DeleteChoiceDialog/RecentActionPill callback chains all wire correctly (bulkMoveTo, bulkDuplicateInPlace, bulkTogglePin, bulkSetColor, bulkSetAlarm, bulkClearAlarm, bulkExportPDF, performArchive, performTrash, undoRecentAction, clearSelection, setDeleteChoice, setBatchStudioOpen). Settings notification toggles all 3 present (notif-toggle-weekly-recap, notif-toggle-chore-summary, notif-toggle-pantry-expiration). Two-step Clear-All-Data confirmed via SettingsModal → clear-confirm-step-1 (data-testid) → clear-step-1-yes → clear-confirm-step-2 (data-testid) → clear-step-2-no (safe abort — no data wiped). LockScreen NOT visible on load (Security disabled) — 0 lock-screen elements. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors captured across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: AppModals.jsx (420 lines) is a clean dumb-component mount point. All ~85 props are passed by name only; internal logic is limited to (a) close-handlers that also reset editing state (e.g., NoteModal onClose also setEditingNote(null)), (b) the FloatingCalendarModal onCreateEvent handler that constructs a Calendar note inline, and (c) two useGroceryQuickAdd callsites (Barcode onCapture, Pantry onSendToShoppingList). Prop-name mapping was verified live for every modal that could be exercised — no typos found.

useGroceryQuickAdd.js is a small (~59 line) pure hook: filters notes for the newest non-archived Grocery-tagged note; appends a checklist item or creates a new Shopping List note. Cleanly used inside AppModals by both Barcode (with barcode/nutrition/nutriscore fields) and Pantry (with dept). Toast messages match the previous inline behaviour ('"X" added to "Y"' vs 'New Shopping List created with "X"'). Meal-Planner-generated grocery notes flow through a different path (MealPlannerModal→onGeneratedGroceryNote→fetchData) and were also confirmed working.

Two-step Clear-All-Data dialogs are now co-located inside AppModals.jsx (previously inline in NotesApp) with data-testids preserved: clear-confirm-step-1, clear-step-1-yes/no, clear-confirm-step-2, clear-step-2-yes/no. All render correctly.
LockScreen mount inside AppModals correctly consumes p.autoLock.locked / p.autoLock.unlock — no lock overlay leaks when Security is disabled.

Minor (pre-existing, from prior iterations, not touched by refactor): PantryModal Unit Select still has a React key warning; TripJournalModal has a nested <button> hydration warning. Neither surfaced in this iteration's flows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executable refactor-touching flows (12/12 header modals, FAB add, meal-planner grocery gen, multi-select→batch studio→delete-choice→archive→undo pill, settings notif toggles, clear-all 2-step, LockScreen absence) — zero console errors

seed_data_creation: None required — app auto-restored 4 seed notes from server; one 'TEST_RefactorNote' created via FAB and one 'Grocery / Shopping list' note created organically via Meal Planner during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AppModals.jsx (notes/AppModals.jsx) + useGroceryQuickAdd (hooks/useGroceryQuickAdd.js) refactor from iteration 27 is regression-clean. If future iterations touch either file: (1) re-verify all 12 header data-testids still open a role=dialog / testid modal (spot-checked list is in the AppModals.jsx import block), (2) re-verify meal-generate-list-btn creates a Grocery note and closes the meal planner (onGeneratedGroceryNote wiring), (3) re-verify multi-select → bs-delete → delete-choice-archive → recent-action-pill Undo restores. NOTE: In the test session, a lingering 'Restored 4 notes from server' toast (upper-right sonner overlay) briefly blocked header-barcode / header-insights clicks in sequential tests — this is a testing-artifact only, not an app bug; sanity clean-slate run confirmed both open fine. If a future test needs to hit those buttons back-to-back, either dismiss toasts first or wait 4s+ for auto-dismiss.
rca of the issue: N/A — refactor is regression-free. AppModals prop mapping is correct for every callback path exercised (add-note, meal-planner grocery gen, multi-select bulk ops incl. batch studio, delete-choice archive/trash, recent-action pill undo, clear-all 2-step, settings notif toggles, LockScreen). Barcode manual-entry + Pantry send-to-shopping-list rely on useGroceryQuickAdd which is unchanged in behaviour from the inline version validated in iteration 26.
